title: The Hom complex into K-injective complexes respects quasi-isomorphisms with independent coefficient universe
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Let $s:(\mathcal I')^\bullet\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ be a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] between K-injective complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and $t:(\mathcal L')^\bullet\to\mathcal L^\bullet$ a quasi-isomorphism of cochain complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Then the morphism of Hom complexes [def-pur-hom-complex]

$$
 \mathcal Hom^\bullet(\mathcal L^\bullet,(\mathcal I')^\bullet)\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom^\bullet((\mathcal L')^\bullet,\mathcal I^\bullet),\qquad f\longmapsto s\circ f\circ t,
$$

is a quasi-isomorphism. This universe-general form takes C : Type u with Category v and coefficient/module universe max u v r, for arbitrary r; assume abelian-group sheafification and its locally bijective characterization on the original site. It uses the same sheaves, restriction, Hom complex, differentials, and induced maps as the original source statement.

proof.text: Work with objects in Type u, arrows in Type v, and coefficient rings and modules in Type (max u v r). Use the existing siteAbelianHasSheafify and siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective instances on the slice whenever an abelian or exactness instance is needed. All these instances are proved, and the given base-site instances are retained.

Apply lem-pur-hom-complex-sections-quasi-iso to s and t over every site object. The resulting sectionwise quasi-isomorphism satisfies the hypothesis of the fully proved general criterion lem-pur-quasi-iso-of-sections, which gives the asserted sheaf quasi-isomorphism.
